2607.09562.title: TCLA: Training-Free Class-wise Logit Adaptation for Medical Vision-Language Models
2607.09562.paper_summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot performance, yet their effectiveness still declines on out-of-distribution (OOD) data due to domain shifts and class bias inherited from large-scale pretraining. Existing few-shot adaptation methods typically introduce additional trainable components, which can be unstable in extremely low-data regimes (e.g., 1-shot), and lack robustness on different medical data. We present TCLA, a purely training-free few-shot adaptation method for Medical VLMs, which is fast and model-agnostic. TCLA corrects inference logits based on a small set of support samples, boosting pretrained VLMs performance by improving inter-class deconfusion and reducing domain shift. Extensive experiments on nine datasets across multiple medical imaging modalities including X-ray, Ultrasound, MRI, CT, Histopathology, demonstrate that TCLA consistently improves OOD performance of Medical VLMs and, in most of cases, outperforms existing training-based adaptation methods.
2607.09562.paper_summary_zh: 醫療視覺-語言模型（VLMs）展現出強大的零-shot 表現，然而，由於從大規模預訓練中繼承的領域轉移和類別偏差，它們在分佈外（OOD）數據上的效能仍然下降。現有的少量樣本適應方法通常會引入額外的可訓練組件，這在極低數據環境下（例如，1-shot）可能不穩定，且在不同的醫療數據上缺乏穩健性。我們提出了 TCLA，一種純粹無需訓練的醫療 VLMs 少量樣本適應方法，該方法快速且與模型無關。TCLA 根據一小組支持樣本修正推理邏輯，通過改善類間去混淆和減少領域轉移來提升預訓練 VLMs 的性能。在九個數據集上進行的廣泛實驗，涵蓋多種醫療影像模式，包括 X 光、超聲波、MRI、CT 和組織病理學，證明 TCLA 一致性地改善了醫療 VLMs 的 OOD 表現，並且在大多數情況下超越了現有的基於訓練的適應方法。
2607.09562.author: Tianyou Jiang et.al.
